functions.name: frexp
functions.notes: IEEE-754 frexp: normalize the fraction into [0.5,1), scale subnormals by 2^64 recursively, write exponent-1022 (or the adjusted subnormal exponent) through the pointer, and pass infinities/NaNs through unchanged.

validation.comparison: 16 inputs cover zero, signed zero, normals, powers of two, subnormals, infinities and NaN. Each compares the returned fraction (Object.is, NaN-aware), stored exponent, all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer.
limitations: Signaling-NaN payload preservation is compared bitwise by the returned value and memory.
Ledger: 429 client bodies recovered and 3,816 remain machine code.
